answer: Each identity survives only by burning one copper token per epoch, earned solely from verified deliveries — a glacier that melts unless fed. The token is minted from a kernel of real work: ten completed deliveries countersigned by unrelated clients. A fake swarm of 100 identities must burn 100 tokens every epoch, costing 5,000 units of forged work, while an honest agent earns its single token from ordinary trade. The attacker pays 100 times the honest cost, every epoch, forever.
